name: Sell Personal Agents with Pickaxe
maker_comment_excerpt: Hey Product Hunt, I’m Chris from Pickaxe 👋 We’re building Pickaxe to help people sell agents as a service, using the expertise they already have. If you know how to solve a problem for someone, we want to help you turn that knowledge into an agent they can use and pay for, with your own brand and customer experience.
